content: It is clear that the performance drops a lot when the training and testing data mismatch, indicating that model training on ASR hypotheses can not generalize well on reference transcriptions. The performance gap is nearly 20% F1 score (72% to 55%). The row (c) shows the improved performance when testing on S-SQuAD due to the transfer learning via fine-tuning.
